# Copilot code review

Read `AGENTS.md` and the applicable guides in `docs/` before reviewing. Check whether changes to behavior also need
changes to the relevant docs. Focus on correctness, edge cases, resource cleanup, security, and meaningful tests.
Report actionable findings with a file and line, the failing scenario, and a concrete fix. Leave formatting and other
mechanical rules to `make lint`.

Keep comments concise and aimed at the code, never the author.
